feature_contract.goal: Preserve the original central C993 sun's exact game-created c64 WVP through physical R84 left and right eye GPU submissions, even when a nested native left Draw restores its shader, source and pose after replacing the original GPU matrix.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only the original direct C993 centre, not CABE outer halos, SkyGlow, ordinary roads, +TIME, GOAL, DX9Ex rollback, input or FFB.
trace_stages: Original D3A5 calls C993 and publishes source-owned original game shader c64 WVP with a monotonic successful upload serial.
R84 R30 proves raw game C993 producer matrix and builds two eye constants while its native R33 left GPU Draw may reenter.
R84 R33 snapshots before left and rechecks the actual successful game c64 upload generation after left before any right-eye emission.
On a changed or missing GPU matrix R33 restores original c64 and vetoes this frame without a duplicate original left draw.
subcomponents: Capture original game c64 upload serial and producer/pose/shader provenance on both sides of the physical left native GPU Draw.
Reject same-producer nested GPU upload replacement and missing proof with a portable regression while keeping original fallbacks and unrelated halo sources.

diagnosis.root_cause: R33's physical stereo reentrancy fence compared source call/draw/shader/pose but not the monotonic original-game c64 GPU upload generation already published in outrun_renderer.cpp.
diagnosis.original_evidence: Successful game c64 writes increment LastGameWvpWriteSerial; source-only R33 captureCentreSource excluded that value despite earlier R30 source WVP proof.
source_trace: Original C993 produces game WVP and successful write serial.
R30 builds eye matrices using game raw c64 provenance.
R33 native left Draw may synchronously cause another write; right must compare the original serial before submission.
alternatives_rejected: Unconditional GPU Flush, generic world shader inference and repeating producer registration do not guarantee identical physical c64 input.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Exact left source and original game matrix must survive as one GPU submission identity for right; otherwise frame invalidation retains original single native left.
